held_out.note: Strict 0.5 IoU matching; includes avatar/HUD occlusion and ten background negatives. Nearby same-trial captures are calibration, not independent accuracy evidence.

limitations: Only the five listed observed enemy appearances are represented; not a general HSR monster detector.
Native calibration images are nearby views from the same trials, not independent accuracy evidence.
Progress-banner occlusion gives an inaccurate final-boss box; bright spawn effects hide the new celestial appearance in a held-out frame.
A detection supplies a coarse bearing only; the live attack reticle must authorize attack.
Raw images, reviewed annotations, generated scenes and checkpoints remain under ignored runs/.
